description: Retention of existing uPVC windows and replacement of remaining timber windows with new uPVC windows
decision_conditions: The proposed window alterations, by reason of their design, scale and proportions would result in an obtrusive and incompatible form of development which would fail to respect the character and appearance of the subject property, the neighbouring conservation areas and the surrounding area. As such the proposed development is contrary to policies 7.4 (Local character), 7.6 (Architecture) and 7.8 (Heritage assets and archaeology) of the London Plan (2106), policy 24 (Design) of the Core Strategy (2010), policy DM1 (High Quality Design) and DM28 (Managing the historic environment) of the Development Management Local Plan (2015) and policies LP1 (Design quality and local character) and LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) of the emerging LP33.
